'''Musarin''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]]. 

==Appearance==
She is tall and aging. She has white hair.{{ref/book|12|6}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Musarin}} Her hair color implies she is significantly more than two hundred years old.

== Activities ==
She is guarding [[Leane Sharif]] when [[Egwene al'Vere]] comes to visit her in the cells. A [[bubble of evil]] erupts and begins to melt Leane's cell. Leane is saved when [[Gelarna]] and Musarin pull her out of the cell with [[weave]]s of [[Air]].{{ref/book|12|6}}
